title: Syrian Orange Flatbread
description: A flavorful flatbread recipe inspired by Syrian cuisine, topped with a sweet orange syrup and flaky crust.

ingredients.name: Orange syrup
ingredients.notes: see notes for orange syrup recipe

instructions: Brush the flatbread with melted butter on both sides.
Sprinkle the orange zest, sugar, cinnamon, and cardamom over the flatbread.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the flatbread is baking, heat the orange syrup in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the flatbread is done, brush it with the warm orange syrup.
Serve warm, garnished with additional orange zest if desired.
